SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.title, c.subtitle, c.cover, c.category_id, c.status, c.article_count, c.subscribe_count, c.view_count, c.is_finished, c.price, c.created_time, pu.nickname AS author_name, pu.avatar AS author_avatar FROM portal_column c LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = c.user_id WHERE c.status = 'published'
AND (c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR c.subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND c.category_id = #{query.categoryId}
ORDER BY c.view_count DESC, c.created_time DESC
ORDER BY c.subscribe_count DESC, c.created_time DESC
ORDER BY c.created_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.title, c.subtitle, c.description, c.cover, c.category_id, c.status, c.article_count, c.subscribe_count, c.view_count, c.is_finished, c.price, c.created_time, c.updated_time, pu.nickname AS author_name, pu.avatar AS author_avatar, pu.bio AS author_bio FROM portal_column c LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = c.user_id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.title, c.subtitle, c.cover, c.category_id, c.status, c.article_count, c.subscribe_count, c.view_count, c.is_finished, c.price, c.created_time, pu.nickname AS author_name, pu.avatar AS author_avatar FROM portal_column c LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = c.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.title, c.subtitle, c.cover, c.category_id, c.status, c.article_count, c.subscribe_count, c.view_count, c.is_finished, c.price, c.created_time, pu.nickname AS author_name, pu.avatar AS author_avatar FROM portal_column c INNER JOIN portal_column_subscribe s ON s.column_id = c.id AND s.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = c.user_id ORDER BY s.created_time DESC
